title: A Lake a Kilometre and a Half Down
subtitle: 行星探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 行星探索（自然科学·宇宙探索）
meta: 主题语境：行星探索（自然科学·宇宙探索）　|　核心词汇：surface　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surface 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The rover has been on the ① surface for eleven years, ten longer than anybody planned, and it has travelled thirty-one kilometres, thirty further than anybody planned. The ② surface temperature where it stands falls to minus eighty at night; the rover sleeps through it and wakes at six, and nothing on the surface moves.

③ On the surface, the place is a desert, and the first eleven photographs it sent back were of a desert, and the newspapers printed them and lost interest. The ④ surface of the ground is dust two centimetres deep over rock, and under the surface the rock is older than anything on this planet.

Eleven years ago an orbiter with radar on it found something under the south pole: a lake, twenty kilometres across. The ⑤ surface of that lake is a kilometre and a half down, which is a long way to dig and a short way to think about. Nothing has touched it. Rock that ⑥ surfaces anywhere else on that planet has been in the open air for three billion years, and rock under a lake has not.

The questions ⑦ surfaced slowly, as they do. The first was whether anything could live in water that cold and that salt; the second was whether we would be able to drill a kilometre and a half without putting anything of ours into it. The woman who had run the radar for eleven years ⑧ surfaced at a press conference in 2019 and said the second question was the one that kept her awake, and that nobody had answered it.

⑨ Beneath the surface, then, is where the story is: a lake, twenty kilometres across, three billion years old, untouched. The ⑩ surface is the part we have photographed eleven thousand times; everything beneath the surface is the part we have never seen at all. My daughter asked me last week why we go there. I said because it is there. She said that is the answer people give when they have not thought about it, and she is eleven.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 表面；外层；地表
C. v. 露出地表；浮现出来（岩石等）
D. v. （问题、事实）显露；被披露
F. adj. 表面的；表层的
G. 固定搭配：on the surface 表面上；乍看
H. 固定搭配：beneath / below the surface 表面之下；实质上

items.q: has been on the surface for eleven years
The surface temperature where it stands
On the surface, the place is a desert
The surface of the ground is dust
the surface of that lake is a kilometre
surfaced at a press conference in 2019
Beneath the surface, then, is where the story is
The surface is the part we have photographed

answers.why: the surface 意为“（行星的）表面、地表”，探测器已在地表工作了十一年。
surface 作形容词，意为“表面的、表层的”，它所在位置的地表温度夜间降到零下八十度。
on the surface 意为“表面上、乍看”，表面上那地方是一片沙漠。
the surface of the ground 意为“地面的表层”，地面表层是两厘米厚的浮尘，下面是岩石。
the surface of that lake 意为“那个湖的水面”，那个湖的水面在一公里半以下。
surfaces 是动词，意为“露出地表”，那颗行星上别处露出地表的岩石已在空气中暴露了三十亿年。
surfaced 意为“（问题）显露、浮现出来”，这些问题慢慢地浮现出来。
surfaced 意为“（人）露面、出现”，主持雷达项目十一年的那位女士在 2019 年的一场记者会上露面。
beneath the surface 意为“表面之下、实质上”，表面之下才是这个故事所在之处。
the surface 意为“表面”，表面是我们拍了一万一千次的那一部分。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 探测器已在地表工作了十一年，比任何人计划的都长了十年。（surface）
它所在位置的地表温度夜间降到零下八十度。（surface）
表面上那地方是一片沙漠，报纸登了照片就没了兴趣。（on the surface）
那个湖的水面在一公里半以下，什么也没碰过它。（surface）
这些问题慢慢地浮现出来，先是关于生命，后是关于钻井。（surface）
表面之下才是故事所在：一个二十公里宽、三十亿年的湖。（beneath the surface）
answers: The rover has been on the surface for eleven years, ten longer than anybody planned.
The surface temperature where it stands falls to minus eighty at night.
On the surface, the place is a desert, and the newspapers printed the photographs and lost interest.
The surface of that lake is a kilometre and a half down, and nothing has touched it.
The questions surfaced slowly: the first was about life, the second about drilling.
Beneath the surface is where the story is: a lake twenty kilometres across, three billion years old.
